articles.title: ZipCodec: Ultra-Low-Frame-Rate Streaming Speech Coding
articles.zh: ZipCodec：超低帧率流式语音编码
articles.summary: 如果你在做实时语音通话或语音Agent，这套编码方案能在极低帧率下保住音质，带宽成本能明显压下来
articles.author: Luca Della Libera, Cem Subakan 等
articles.body: Neural audio codecs are a fundamental component of modern speech generation systems. While recent codecs achieve increasingly low bitrates, reducing frame rate remains challenging, as each token must preserve more information while maintaining reconstruction quality. We present ZipCodec, a streaming neural speech codec operating at 6.25 Hz and 0.80 kbps with a theoretical latency of 160 ms. Our approach combines large-scale WavLM distillation with a redesigned transformer-based architecture, a scalar spherical quantizer, and a latency-aware streaming decoder. Experiments show that ZipCodec substantially outperforms existing streaming codecs at comparable bitrates in both reconstruction and downstream tasks, while operating at a significantly lower frame rate. Despite its 842M parameters, ZipCodec achieves real-time single-stream inference on a consumer-grade CPU. Demo samples, code and checkpoints are available at https://lucadellalib.github.io/zipcodec-web/.
articles.bodyZh: 神经音频编解码器（neural audio codec）可以说是现代语音生成系统的基础组件。最近这些编解码器能把比特率（bitrate）压得越来越低，但帧率（frame rate）想再往下降就很难了——因为每个词元（token）得扛更多信息，同时还得保证重建出来的音质不掉链子。我们推出了 ZipCodec，一个流式（streaming）神经语音编解码器，帧率做到 6.25 赫兹，比特率 0.80 kbps，理论延迟（latency）只有 160 毫秒。我们的思路是把大规模 WavLM 蒸馏、重新设计的 Transformer 架构、标量球面量化器（scalar spherical quantizer），还有能感知延迟的流式解码器全都整合到一起。实验表明，在比特率差不多的情况下，ZipCodec 不管是在重建还是下游任务上，都明显甩开现有的流式编解码器，而且帧率低得多。别看它有 842M 参数（parameter），在普通消费级 CPU 上照样能实时单流推理（real-time single-stream inference）。演示样本、代码和模型检查点都在 https://lucadellalib.github.io/zipcodec-web/。

articles.title: LoaDiff: Conditional Generation of Electricity Consumption Time Series for Energy Analytics
articles.zh: LoaDiff：面向能源分析的用电量时间序列条件生成
articles.summary: 如果你需要电力负荷数据却拿不到真实用户数据，这个扩散模型能按条件合成可用的用电曲线
articles.author: Mariia Baranova, Adrien Petralia 等
articles.body: The energy transition is reshaping residential electricity consumption through the increasing adoption of distributed generation, electrified appliances, and demand-response programs. Understanding these evolving behaviors requires access to granular smart-meter data for applications such as load forecasting, appliance detection, and demand-side flexibility analysis. However, such data are subject to strict access restrictions and data-protection regulations. Thus, realistic synthetic alternatives are necessary. In this paper, we introduce LoaDiff, a diffusion-based generative model for year-long, sub-hourly smart-meter load curves. LoaDiff supports flexible conditioning on static household attributes, such as appliance ownership, and dynamic contextual variables, including calendar information and outdoor temperature. We evaluate the model against multiple generative baselines on three residential electricity-consumption datasets. Our experiments assess four complementary dimensions: fidelity and diversity, training-record memorization risk, downstream utility for load forecasting and appliance detection, and conditional controllability under alternative temperature conditions. The results show that LoaDiff generates realistic and diverse load profiles, achieves a favorable trade-off between generation quality and limited evidence of memorization, preserves information useful for downstream energy applications, and responds coherently to changes in conditioning variables.
articles.bodyZh: 能源转型正在重塑居民用电方式，因为分布式发电（distributed generation）、电气化家电和需求响应（demand-response）项目越来越普及。要理解这些不断变化的行为，就需要获取细粒度的智能电表数据，用于负荷预测、电器识别和需求侧灵活性分析等应用。然而，这类数据受到严格的访问限制和数据保护法规约束。因此，现实可用的合成替代数据就很有必要。在这篇论文中，我们介绍了 LoaDiff，这是一种基于扩散（diffusion）的生成模型，用于生成为期一年、时间分辨率低于一小时的智能电表负荷曲线。LoaDiff 支持灵活地以静态家庭属性（比如电器拥有情况）以及动态上下文变量（包括日历信息和室外温度）为条件进行生成。我们在三个居民用电数据集上，将这一模型与多种生成基线进行了评估。我们的实验从四个互补维度进行考察：保真度与多样性、对训练记录的记忆风险、用于负荷预测和电器识别的下游效用，以及在不同温度条件下的条件可控性。结果表明，LoaDiff 能生成真实且多样的负荷曲线，在生成质量和有限的记忆证据之间取得了较好的平衡，保留了可用于下游能源应用的信息，并且能对条件变量的变化作出连贯响应。

articles.title: MAPLE: Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution
articles.zh: MAPLE：融合语言与进化的记忆增强规划方法
articles.summary: 如果你在做Agent的长程规划，这套"记忆+进化搜索"的组合值得直接借鉴思路
articles.author: Kesheng Chen, Yamin Hu 等
articles.body: Domain practitioners understand their business constraints but may lack operations-research expertise or dedicated support. LLM-based optimization agents translate natural-language requirements into models or solver programs that established optimization tools can execute. This progress makes optimization more accessible, but real-world operations are dynamic: changing demand, resources, and priorities require updates to data, constraints, and objectives. Methods centered on isolated requests offer limited support for rapid adaptation that preserves earlier decisions and reuses useful search results. We introduce MAPLE (Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution), an agent for maintaining optimization problems through successive natural-language requests. MAPLE combines language-based problem construction with mathematical programming and evolutionary search. It retains the optimization program, accepted plans, earlier updates, and candidate solutions for subsequent requests. We introduce NLDO, a benchmark of 15 trajectories and 180 updates spanning selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-resource placement. In the main evaluation, MAPLE completes all trajectories and achieves online scalar quality of 0.951 and a Pareto hypervolume ratio of 0.875. Controlled comparisons further show that maintaining executable state improves update validity and can preserve useful search information across substantial revisions.
articles.bodyZh: 做具体业务的人（domain practitioners）往往很清楚自己的业务约束，但可能不懂运筹学（operations research），也没有专门团队支持。基于大语言模型（LLM）的优化智能体（optimization agents），能把自然语言需求转成模型或求解器程序，让成熟的优化工具直接跑起来。这让优化更容易上手，可现实运营是动态变化的：需求、资源和优先级一变，数据、约束和目标就得跟着更新。那些只围着单次、孤立请求转的方法，遇到需要快速适应时就不太顶用，尤其是你还想保住之前的决策、复用有用的搜索结果。我们带来 MAPLE（Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution），它是一个智能体，能通过一连串自然语言请求来持续维护优化问题。MAPLE 把用语言构建问题、数学规划（mathematical programming）和进化搜索（evolutionary search）揉到了一起。它会保留优化程序、已经接受的方案、之前的更新，还有候选解，后面再有请求就能接着用。我们还推出了 NLDO，这是个基准测试（benchmark），有 15 条轨迹（trajectories）、180 次更新（updates），覆盖选择、排程、排班、路线规划和云资源放置这些场景。在主评测里，MAPLE 完成了全部轨迹，在线标量质量（online scalar quality）达到 0.951，帕累托超体积比（Pareto hypervolume ratio）是 0.875。对照实验进一步显示，维护可执行状态（executable state）能提高更新有效性（update validity），就算经历大幅修改，也能把有用的搜索信息保留下来。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks to Infer the Perpendicular Energy Conductivity in the Scrape-Off Layer of Stellarator Devices
articles.zh: 物理信息神经网络用于推断仿星器装置刮削层中的垂直能量传导率
articles.summary: 如果你不做聚变等离子体仿真可以直接跳过；做的话，这是PINN反演输运系数的典型案例
articles.author: J. Gallego, P. Protopapas 等
articles.body: In this work, we develop an inverse Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) framework to infer the dependence of the scrape-off layer (SOL) perpendicular heat conductivity on plasma density and temperature, $κ_\perp(n,T)$. The method combines radial profile measurements of electron density and temperature with the residual of a reduced one-dimensional SOL transport equation, so that the inferred conductivity is constrained by both the measurements and the underlying transport model. Three neural networks are trained simultaneously: two reconstruct the temperature and density profiles as functions of the radial coordinate and transported power, while a third represents the effective conductivity as a function of the local density and temperature. The framework is first validated using synthetic data generated from a prescribed conductivity function, allowing the inferred $κ_\perp(n,T)$ to be compared directly with the ground truth. The model recovers the imposed functional dependence with errors below $10~\%$ in the data-constrained region. Bootstrap resampling is shown to provide a practical indicator of prediction reliability and consistency. A scan in the number of plasma profiles used for training and the number of radial measurement positions per profile identifies a practical trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and data availability. Finally, the method is applied to an experimental dataset from the TJ-II stellarator obtained with the helium-beam diagnostic. This exploratory application provides an initial estimate of the effective SOL conductivity and illustrates the potential of inverse PINNs for extracting transport information from plasma edge measurements.
articles.bodyZh: 在这项工作里，我们搭了一个“逆物理信息神经网络”（inverse Physics-Informed Neural Network, PINN）框架，用来推断刮离层（scrape-off layer, SOL）里垂直于磁场的热导率到底怎么随等离子体密度和温度变化，也就是 $κ_\perp(n,T)$。这个办法把电子密度和温度的径向剖面测量，跟一个简化的一维 SOL 输运方程的残差（residual）结合起来，这样一来，推断出来的热导率既受测量数据约束，也受背后的输运模型约束。我们同时训练三个神经网络：两个负责重建温度和密度剖面，把它们写成径向坐标和输运功率的函数；第三个则表示有效热导率（effective conductivity），把它写成局域密度和温度的函数。这个框架先用合成数据（synthetic data）做了验证，这些数据来自一个事先给定的热导率函数（prescribed conductivity function），这样推断出的 $κ_\perp(n,T)$ 就能直接和真值（ground truth）对比。在数据能约束到的区域里，模型能把设定的函数依赖关系找回来，误差低于 $10\%$。我们还发现，用自助重采样（Bootstrap resampling）能给出一个很实用的指标，用来看预测靠不靠谱、稳不稳定。接着，我们又扫描了训练时用多少个等离子体剖面、每个剖面取多少个径向测量位置，找出重建精度和数据可得性之间一个实际可接受的折中。最后，我们把方法用到 TJ-II 仿星器（stellarator）上，用的是氦束诊断（helium-beam diagnostic）拿到的一组实验数据。这个探索性应用给出了有效 SOL 热导率的一个初步估计，也说明逆 PINN 很有潜力，能从等离子体边缘测量里挖出输运信息。

articles.title: A Training-Free, Alignment-Free Approach to Corporate Intelligence: Application to SEC Filings
articles.zh: 免训练、免对齐的企业情报方法：在SEC文件上的应用
articles.summary: 如果你要靠扒上市公司财报做分析，这条路线说明不微调、不对齐也能跑出结果
articles.author: Jean-François Delpech
articles.body: High-dimensional dense text embeddings and large language models face real obstacles in financial-disclosure analysis: context-window limits, hallucination risk, high computational cost, and the arbitrary rotation of vector spaces across independently trained models. We present a training-free, alignment-free framework for corporate intelligence built on deterministic sparse seed vectors. Hashing word strings into a fixed high-dimensional basis places all documents and all temporal epochs in a common coordinate system by construction, removing any need for training or alignment. Accumulating these seed vectors across sentence contexts yields corpus-specific semantic signatures that compose linearly, supporting sub-second document comparison, issuer fingerprinting, tracking of how an issuer's vocabulary shifts between filings, and thematic sentence extraction, all on ordinary CPU hardware. Demonstrating the approach on a multi-year corpus of SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), we show how material corporate events, among them Boeing's 737 MAX crisis, Intel's supply-chain disruptions, and Bunge's acquisition of Viterra, emerge as distinct, interpretable semantic profiles, each traceable to the exact source sentences that produced it, with no domain-specific training and no LLM inference.
articles.bodyZh: 高维稠密文本嵌入（dense text embeddings）和大语言模型（large language models）在做财报披露分析时，有几道坎是真过不去：上下文窗口（context window）就那么点大，模型容易一本正经地胡说八道，算力成本高得吓人，再加上各家模型独立训练出来，向量空间会各转各的，彼此对不上号。我们提出了一套免训练、免对齐的框架，专门用来做企业情报分析，底层靠的是确定性稀疏种子向量（deterministic sparse seed vectors）。做法很简单：把词串哈希（hash）到一个固定的高维基（basis）上，这么一来，所有文档、所有时间片段从设计上就天然落在同一个坐标系里，训练和对齐这两步压根不需要。把这些种子向量按句子上下文累加起来，就能得到这份语料特有的语义签名（semantic signature），而且这些签名还能线性叠加组合，于是文档比对不到一秒就能出结果，还能给发行主体做指纹识别、追踪某家公司在不同申报文件里用词是怎么变的、把主题句挑出来——这些活儿全都能跑在普通 CPU 硬件上。我们拿美国证监会（SEC）多年的申报文件语料库（10-K、10-Q、8-K）验证了这套方法，结果像波音 737 MAX 危机、英特尔供应链断供、邦吉（Bunge）收购维特拉（Viterra）这些重大企业事件，都浮现出各自独特、看得懂、说得清的语义画像，而且每一处都能追溯到产生它的那几句原文，全程没做任何领域专项训练，也没跑过一次大模型推理。

articles.title: Distributed Optimization of Modular Production Systems using Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Inverse Models
articles.zh: 基于逆模型与模型强化学习的模块化生产系统分布式优化
articles.summary: 如果你关心RL怎么落到工厂产线调度，这篇给的是一套分布式+逆模型的组合方案
articles.author: Andreas Schwung, Steve Yuwono 等
articles.body: This paper presents a novel approach for data-driven self-learning control of highly flexible, modular manufacturing systems. Specifically, we employ a novel framework for model-based reinforcement learning which introduces approximate inverse process models within the training of reinforcement policies. This approach disentangles the learning of actuation dynamics and the dynamics in state space, resulting in RL-based training solely within the task space. We propose a lightweight feedforward architecture for approximate inverse models and integrate them within the policy network of standard RL algorithms. We apply the approach to a laboratory modular production testbed with heterogeneous production modules. The results underline the efficiency improvements for modular manufacturing units in terms of both performance and training speed, particularly for off-policy algorithms.
articles.bodyZh: 这篇论文提出了一种新方法，用来对高度灵活、模块化的制造系统做数据驱动自学习控制（data-driven self-learning control）。具体来说，我们用一个全新的基于模型的强化学习（model-based reinforcement learning）框架，在训练强化学习策略（reinforcement policies）时，把近似逆过程模型（approximate inverse process models）加了进去。这个做法把驱动动力学（actuation dynamics）的学习和状态空间（state space）里的动力学学习拆开了，所以强化学习训练只在任务空间（task space）里进行。我们还提出了一种轻量级的前馈架构（feedforward architecture）来做近似逆模型，并把它整合进标准强化学习算法的策略网络（policy network）里。然后，我们把这个方法应用到了一个实验室的模块化生产测试平台（modular production testbed）上，这个平台包含各种异构的生产模块（heterogeneous production modules）。结果说明，模块化制造单元在性能和训练速度上都有效率提升，尤其是对离策略算法（off-policy algorithms）来说更明显。

articles.title: Making Alternative Data Work: Context-Augmented LLMs for Financial Forecasting
articles.zh: 让另类数据真正可用：面向金融预测的上下文增强LLM
articles.summary: 如果你做量化想用另类数据，这篇提醒你光把数据喂进去没用，得先给模型补上下文
articles.author: Jihoon Kwon, Lawrence Liu 等
articles.body: When forecasting a firm's future financial performance, alternative data - data collected from non-traditional sources such as consumer transactions, web traffic, and prediction markets - can provide timely signals about firms' operating activities and broader market conditions. These signals may reveal information that is not captured by traditional public sources and can therefore provide complementary information for forecasting firms' future financial performance. However, firm-level alternative data often have limited historical coverage, are relevant only to specific prediction targets or subsets of firms, and are distributed across numerous heterogeneous channels, making them difficult to incorporate flexibly into conventional forecasting approaches. Meanwhile, large language models (LLMs) can interpret instructions, learn from in-context examples, and generate predictions by combining heterogeneous information without task-specific parameter updates. Motivated by this potential flexibility, we investigate whether an LLM can forecast firm performance by integrating alternative data with other financial information through in-context learning. We propose a two-agent framework that first identifies the firms for which each alternative data channel is likely to be informative and then predicts revenue using firm- and channel-specific context. We evaluate the framework across four commercial alternative data channels. In our experiments, adding alternative data in context alongside other financial information improves the LLM's forecasting relative to either source alone, and these forecasts are more accurate than those of standard forecasting baselines. These findings suggest that LLMs provide a flexible and practical approach to integrating alternative data with heterogeneous financial information.
articles.bodyZh: 当我们要预测一家公司未来的财务表现时，另类数据（alternative data）——也就是从消费者交易（consumer transactions）、网络流量（web traffic）、预测市场（prediction markets）这些非传统来源收集来的数据——能及时透露出公司经营活动和整体市场状况的信号。这些信号可能带来传统公开来源没抓到的信息，所以能给预测公司未来财务表现提供补充信息。但问题是，公司层面的另类数据往往历史覆盖有限，只对特定预测目标或一部分公司有用，还散落在大量不同渠道里，想灵活塞进传统预测方法并不容易。与此同时，大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）能读懂指令，从上下文示例里学习，把五花八门的信息合在一起生成预测，还不用针对某个任务去更新参数。正是看中这种潜在灵活性，我们研究了一件事：大语言模型能不能通过上下文学习（in-context learning），把另类数据和其他财务信息整合起来，用来预测公司表现。我们提出一个双智能体框架（two-agent framework）：先找出每个另类数据渠道可能对哪些公司有信息价值，再用公司和渠道各自的上下文来预测营收。我们在四个商业另类数据渠道（commercial alternative data channels）上评估了这个框架。实验里，把另类数据和其他财务信息一起放进上下文，比只用其中一种来源，大语言模型的预测表现更好；这些预测也比标准预测基线（standard forecasting baselines）更准。这些发现说明，大语言模型提供了一种灵活又实用的办法，能把另类数据和各种不同的财务信息整合起来。
